_comment: Company capex guidance (T2: company statement, not audited). Each company defines capex its own way (Meta includes principal payments on finance leases; Microsoft speaks of capex including finance leases; Oracle separates gross capex from net cash capex; Amazon speaks of cash capex). Guidance is never mixed into the reported (T1) series. Sources: FactSet guidance dataset (company-provided guidance as FactSet records it; snapshot date in pulledAt) and, where the dataset lags the call, the licensed earnings-call transcript (FactSet CallStreet; no public link, like the Oracle figures). US$ millions. Update after each earnings call; checkedOn = the last in-session re-check of the dataset.

items.note_en: Microsoft gives no annual capex range; FactSet's guidance dataset has none for FY2026 or FY2027.
items.note_es: Microsoft no da un rango anual de capex; el conjunto de guías de FactSet no registra ninguno para el AF2026 ni el AF2027.
items.source_es: Conjunto de guías de FactSet (CAPEX), consulta del 3 oct 2026; revisado de nuevo el 9 oct 2026
items.source_en: FactSet guidance dataset (CAPEX), pulled 3 Oct 2026; rechecked 9 Oct 2026

items.source_es: Conjunto de guías de FactSet (CAPEX), guía del 23 jul 2026 (resultados del 2T26)
items.source_en: FactSet guidance dataset (CAPEX), guidance dated 23 Jul 2026 (Q2 2026 results)

items.note_en: Raised on the Q2 2026 call (30 Jul 2026) from about US$200 bn (6 Feb 2026) to about US$220 bn of cash capex, which Amazon attributed to the higher cost of memory. FactSet's guidance dataset had not recorded the change as of 9 Oct 2026, so the figure comes from the licensed transcript (company statement, T2).
items.note_es: Elevada en la llamada del 2T26 (30 jul 2026) de unos US$200 mil M (6 feb 2026) a unos US$220 mil M de capex en efectivo, que Amazon atribuyó al mayor costo de la memoria. El conjunto de guías de FactSet no registraba el cambio al 9 oct 2026, así que la cifra viene de la transcripción con licencia (declaración de la empresa, T2).
items.source_es: Llamada de resultados de Amazon del 2T26 (30 jul 2026), comentarios preparados del director general; transcripción con licencia, sin enlace público. El conjunto de guías de FactSet aún registra la cifra del 6 feb 2026 (US$200 mil M) al 9 oct 2026
items.source_en: Amazon Q2 2026 earnings call (30 Jul 2026), the chief executive's prepared remarks; licensed transcript, no public link. FactSet's guidance dataset still records the 6 Feb 2026 figure (US$200 bn) as of 9 Oct 2026
items.quote: We now believe we will spend approximately $220 billion in cash CapEx in 2026. The higher cost of memory pushing this number up from our prior estimate of about $200 billion.

items.note_en: Meta's capex definition includes principal payments on finance leases.
items.note_es: La definición de capex de Meta incluye los pagos de principal de arrendamientos financieros.
items.source_es: Conjunto de guías de FactSet (CAPEX), guía del 30 jul 2026 (resultados del 2T26)
items.source_en: FactSet guidance dataset (CAPEX), guidance dated 30 Jul 2026 (Q2 2026 results)

items.note_en: $90-95bn of capex, of which not more than $70bn net cash capex (the rest funded by partners/customers), per the Q1 FY2027 call, p. 4.
items.note_es: US$90-95 mil millones de capex, de los cuales no más de US$70 mil millones de capex neto en efectivo (el resto lo financian socios/clientes), según la llamada del 1T AF2027, p. 4.
items.source_es: Llamada de resultados de Oracle del 1T AF2027 (10 sep 2026), p. 4 de la transcripción con licencia (sin enlace público)
items.source_en: Oracle Q1 FY2027 earnings call (10 Sep 2026), p. 4 of the licensed transcript (no public link)
